shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: Currently I have equal amounts (1 each) of A, C, and B. Trading away my only A for another B would leave me with 0 A and 2 B, which reduces variety and hurts my utility since I value diversity across goods. I'd rather keep balanced holdings unless the trade improves my variety.
